en.headline: MTR completes first phase of Tung Chung Line track diversion
en.dek: From 13 September, trains leaving Tung Chung for Hong Kong will run on the new section linking to the future Tung Chung East station; journey times and frequencies remain unchanged.
body: The MTR Corporation said on Friday that the first phase of major track diversion works for the Tung Chung Line Extension had been completed successfully. The new Hong Kong-bound section, which will serve the future Tung Chung East station, has passed safety approvals from government departments.

Starting from Sunday 13 September, trains departing from Tung Chung station towards Hong Kong will switch to the new alignment. The operator said overall journey times in that direction would remain broadly the same as at present and that service frequencies would be unchanged.

With the Hong Kong-bound diversion finished, teams will next remove sections of the old track to create space for the reverse-direction works. The remaining turnout installations for the Tung Chung-bound track are scheduled for 2026 and 2027. The full Tung Chung Line Extension project is targeted for completion in 2029.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌綫延線路軌改道首階段完成
zh.dek: 9月13日起由東涌開出往香港方向列車將改行新路段，接駁未來東涌東站；行車時間及班次維持不變。
body: 港鐵公司周五表示，東涌綫延綫東涌東段大型路軌改道工程首階段已順利完成。連接未來東涌東站、往香港方向的新路段已通過政府部門安全審批。
由9月13日（周日）起，由東涌站開出往香港方向的列車將改經新路段行駛。港鐵指新路段投入後，該方向整體行車時間與現時大致相若，班次亦維持不變。
港鐵表示，隨着往香港方向首階段改道完成，正準備展開下一階段往東涌方向的路軌改道，包括拆除部分不再使用的舊路軌以騰出空間。餘下兩次關鍵道岔安裝預計於2026至2027年進行，整個東涌綫延綫項目目標於2029年完成。
